extension.summary: Canadian weather from Environment and Climate Change Canada
extension.description: Hourly and 7-day forecasts, alerts and sunrise/sunset for Canadian cities from Environment and Climate Change Canada (api.weather.gc.ca), with current conditions for the exact location from Open-Meteo. No API key required. Refreshes every 15 minutes.
extension.disclaimer: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada. Current conditions and location search: Open-Meteo.com, CC BY 4.0. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Environment and Climate Change Canada.
extension.news: v1.1.0: current conditions from Open-Meteo for the exact location, 15-minute refresh, one-decimal temperature and alert properties for skins.
